use_app_login.name: Use app login
use_app_login.description: Send over the Anova app login instead of the Personal Access Token.

init.title: Anova app login (optional)
init.description: Your Personal Access Token is not allowed to control the lamp. Signing in with your Anova app email and password lets Home Assistant send lamp commands the way the app does. Only works for email/password accounts (not Apple or Google sign-in). Unofficial: it may stop working if Anova changes its app. Your password is not stored. Leave the email empty to remove the login.
